title: Merrick Preaching Visits, 1742
summary: A Long Island Historical Journal article on Reverend Azariah Horton's 1742 mission journal records stops among Native groups at Merrick and neighboring places including Rockaway, Jerusalem/Wantagh, and Fort Neck. Horton's journal places Native people in the Merrick area generations after early colonial land transactions, showing continuity across western Long Island communities.
ancestral_territory_note: Linked to Merrick Ancestral Land as eighteenth-century evidence of Native presence in the Merrick area.
why_this_matters: Horton's Merrick visits are evidence that Native people remained present and connected across western Long Island in the eighteenth century. The history challenges disappearance narratives and places Merrick within a living regional Native geography.
